title: 依赖图
description: 以分层方式绘制的有向无环图：包依赖、构建流水线、数据血缘、任务计划。Sugiyama 布局会打破环、分配层级、为跨层的边插入虚拟节点、减少交叉并让长边保持笔直；边可以是平滑样条或带箭头的正交连线。悬停或选中节点即可高亮其全部上游和下游，还能显示计划的关键路径。

overview.title: 布局原理
overview.text: DependencyGraph 即 layout="dag" 的 GraphChart：方框按标签自适应大小，每条边带箭头，并高亮上下游。同一布局也以纯函数 dagLayout 导出。
overview.layers: 通过反转深度优先搜索中的回边来打破环；层级由最长路径确定，随后把源节点移到其后继旁边，并把出入边数相等的节点移到较空的层。
overview.crossings: 跨越多层的边会插入虚拟节点；再通过重心法和中位数法的多轮上下扫描重排每一层并保留最佳顺序，最后用相邻交换消除剩余交叉。
overview.coordinates: 层内位置由朝向邻居的加权保序回归求得，长边权重很高，因此保持笔直。支持 TB、LR、BT 和 RL 四个方向。
overview.highlight: highlight="lineage"（此处的默认值）会高亮悬停、聚焦或选中节点的全部祖先和后代；criticalPath 高亮总时长（节点 value）最长的链路。

props.name: direction
props.description: Flow direction

props.name: dag
props.description: Layer / node spacing, crossing reduction sweeps

props.name: criticalPath
props.description: Highlights the longest path (node `value` = duration); `true` computes it, a list of ids sets it

props.name: nodes
props.description: The nodes

props.name: edges
props.description: The edges (parent → child in trees, prerequisite → dependent in DAGs)

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups: legend order, names and colors

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: nodeShape
props.description: Shape of the nodes without `shape` (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)

props.name: nodeSize
props.description: Circle diameter in layout units, or `[min, max]` scaled by the node `value`

props.name: edgeStyle
props.description: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted

props.name: edgeWidth
props.description: Edge width in CSS pixels, or `[min, max]` scaled by the edge `value`

props.name: edgeColor
props.description: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads on the edges without `directed`

props.name: arrowStyle
props.description: Shape of the arrowheads: `open` (a slim outlined head) or `filled` (a solid head in the edge color, which follows the theme and the highlight)

props.name: nodeLabels
props.description: Node labels; `auto` hides minor and overlapping labels when zoomed out. Text inside boxes keeps a readable minimum size and is shortened with an ellipsis; it is hidden only when the box is too small for any text, or with `false`

props.name: edgeLabels
props.description: Edge labels: always, `auto` (zoomed in or highlighted), only `hover`, or never

props.name: highlight
props.description: What hovering / selecting a node highlights

props.name: selected
props.description: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection)

props.name: animation
props.description: Animates layout and data changes; a number is the duration in ms

props.name: fitPadding
props.description: Padding around the graph when fitting it, in CSS pixels

props.name: controls
props.description: Zoom buttons (zoom in, zoom out, fit)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend of the groups; shown by default with several groups

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: interaction
props.description: Drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, nodes can be dragged (force, circular), click selects, arrow keys move between nodes; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the nodes and edges: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software

props.name: palette
props.description: Group colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changes

events.name: onItemClick
events.description: Called when a node or an edge is clicked (or a node activated with Enter)

events.name: onSelectionChange
events.description: Called with the ids of the selected nodes when the selection changes

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a tree node is collapsed or expanded

events.name: onGroupToggle
events.description: Called when the legend shows / hides a group

events.name: onLayoutEnd
events.description: Called when the layout is done (the force simulation cooled down)

events.name: onRendererChange
events.description: Called with the backend once it is ready (and after a fallback)

props.name: direction
props.description: Flow direction

props.name: dag
props.description: Layer / node spacing, crossing reduction sweeps

props.name: criticalPath
props.description: Highlights the longest path (node `value` = duration); `true` computes it, a list of ids sets it

props.name: layerGap
props.description: Space between two layers, in layout units

props.name: nodeGap
props.description: Space between two nodes of a layer, in layout units

props.name: sweeps
props.description: Down / up sweeps of the crossing reduction

props.name: criticalPath
props.description: Highlights the longest path (node `value` = duration, 1 when omitted); `true` computes it, a list of node ids sets it

props.name: criticalColor
props.description: Color of the critical path (any CSS color)

GraphCriticalPath.description: Longest path of a DAG weighted by the node values (durations, 1 when omitted)

props.name: nodes
props.description: Node ids from the start to the end of the path

props.name: edges
props.description: Indices of the edges of the path

props.name: length
props.description: Sum of the node values along the path

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of each node in layout units; 24 × 24 when omitted

props.name: layer
props.description: Layer of each node (0 = first)

props.name: order
props.description: Node indices of each layer, in drawing order (dummy nodes of long edges are negative: `-1 - dummy`)

props.name: routes
props.description: Waypoints of each edge, `[x0, y0, x1, y1, …]` from the source to the target boundary (empty for ignored edges)

props.name: reversed
props.description: Edges reversed to break cycles (indices)

props.name: crossings
props.description: Edge crossings before / after the crossing reduction

examples.title: 构建调度器
examples.description: 任务调度器用 1、2 或 4 个 worker 执行 monorepo 构建，优先启动剩余链路最长的就绪任务。随着计时推进，分组把任务标为已完成、运行中或排队中；节点 value 为耗时，criticalPath 显示无论多少 worker 都无法突破的构建时长下限。

examples.title: 课程先修关系
examples.description: 按学年分组的计算机专业课程。单选按钮在 TB、LR、BT、RL 之间切换方向，节点移动到新的层；点击课程，按课程目录顺序列出修读它之前需要完成的所有课程。

examples.title: 故障影响分析
examples.description: 夜间 ETL 任务：选择失败的任务（或点击节点），其所有下游任务被标记为阻塞，入边改为虚线。highlight="lineage" 配合受控的 selected 显示影响范围，摘要列出无法交付的产出。

examples.title: 上游与下游
examples.description: 从原始表到看板的数据血缘。选中状态会保持血缘高亮：点击模型查看它的来源和去向，按 Esc 或点击背景清除。

examples.title: 包依赖
examples.description: 单体仓库中的包，从应用一直到设计令牌和工具链。开发依赖以虚线表示；悬停某个包可查看它依赖的全部包以及依赖它的全部包。utils 与 i18n 互相依赖：循环依赖以红色的两条独立路线绘制。

examples.title: CI/CD 流水线
examples.description: 从左到右的构建流水线，使用正交连线。分组按状态为任务着色（可在图例中隐藏），节点 value 为耗时，criticalPath 高亮最长的任务链，下方摘要用 criticalPath() 重新计算。构建应用到打包之间传递两个产物（平行边各走各的路线），失败的视觉测试会重试自身（自环）。

examples.title: 项目计划
examples.description: 用关键路径法排定网站上线计划：最早与最晚开始时间得出每个任务的浮动时间，零浮动的链路以 id 列表传给 criticalPath。副标题用 Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatRange 显示工作日区间；点击任务查看其日期与浮动时间。

examples.title: 电子表格重算
examples.description: 订单表中的公式单元格及其引用的单元格。修改输入后，依赖它的单元格会重新计算：被修改的单元格作为 selected 传入，血缘高亮正好显示重算了哪些单元格，副标题用 Intl.NumberFormat 格式化金额与百分比。

DependencyGraphProps.direction: 流向：TB（从上到下）、LR、BT 或 RL
DependencyGraphProps.dag: 布局设置：层间距和节点间距、交叉优化轮数、关键路径及其颜色
DependencyGraphProps.criticalPath: 高亮最长路径（节点 value 为耗时）：true 自动计算，节点 id 列表则直接指定

GraphDagOptions.layerGap: 相邻两层之间的距离（布局单位）
GraphDagOptions.nodeGap: 同层相邻节点之间的距离（布局单位）
GraphDagOptions.sweeps: 交叉优化的上下扫描轮数
GraphDagOptions.criticalPath: 高亮最长路径：true 根据节点 value 计算，节点 id 列表则直接指定
GraphDagOptions.criticalColor: 关键路径的颜色（任意 CSS 颜色）

GraphCriticalPath.nodes: 路径上从起点到终点的节点 id
GraphCriticalPath.length: 路径上节点 value 之和

GraphDagLayoutOptions.size: 每个节点的宽和高（布局单位）；省略时为 24 × 24

GraphDagLayoutResult.layer: 每个节点所在的层，从 0 开始
GraphDagLayoutResult.order: 每层节点的绘制顺序；长边的虚拟节点为负数
GraphDagLayoutResult.routes: 每条边从起点边界到终点边界的路径点（被忽略的边为空）
GraphDagLayoutResult.reversed: 为打破环而反转的边的索引
GraphDagLayoutResult.crossings: 交叉优化前后的边交叉数

pipeline.title: CI 流水线与关键路径
pipeline.description: 任务从左到右排列，使用直角连线；任务时长即其数值，因此最长的任务链会被高亮，开关可将其关闭。

modules.title: 模块依赖链
modules.description: 按层级排列的 Web 应用模块；悬停或点击模块会高亮它依赖的全部模块以及依赖它的全部模块，并在下方显示当前选择。

props.height: 图表高度（包含图例）：像素或任意 CSS 长度
props.nodes: 节点 { id, label, group, value… }；仅属性
props.edges: 连线 { source, target, value, label… }；仅属性
props.groups: 分组 { id, name, color }：图例顺序、名称与颜色；仅属性
props.nodeShape: 未设置 shape 的节点形状（DAG、组织架构图和思维导图为方框，其余为圆形）
props.edgeStyle: 连线形状；省略时取决于布局
props.edgeColor: 连线颜色：中性色，或使用起点 / 终点节点的颜色
props.arrowStyle: 箭头形状：open（细长的描边箭头）或 filled（与边同色的实心箭头，跟随主题与高亮）
props.highlight: 悬停 / 选中节点时高亮的内容
props.locale: 内置文本（摘要、播报、提示框、按钮）的语言；默认为页面语言
props.selected: 选中节点的 id（修改后会更新选择）；仅属性
props.instance: 引擎实例（minerva-design/charts/core），元素渲染并连接到文档前为 null

events.minerva-hover: 悬停（或键盘聚焦）的节点 / 连线发生变化；detail：{ type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }，无悬停时为 null
events.minerva-item-click: 点击了节点或连线（或用 Enter 激活了节点）；detail：{ type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }
events.minerva-toggle: 树节点被折叠或展开；detail：{ id, collapsed }
events.minerva-group-toggle: 图例显示 / 隐藏了某个分组；detail：{ group, hidden }
events.minerva-layout-end: 布局完成（力导向模拟已稳定）；detail：{ layout }
events.minerva-renderer-change: 后端已就绪，或在 GPU 丢失后回退；detail：{ renderer }

methods.fit: 将可见节点适配到视图中
methods.focusNode: 将某个节点居中（展开其已折叠的祖先），可选缩放
methods.setData: 替换数据，直到属性再次变化
methods.select: 选择节点（null 清除选择）
methods.expand: 展开一个节点（不传 id 时展开全部）
methods.collapse: 折叠一个节点（不传 id 时折叠所有有子节点的节点）
methods.toggle: 折叠 / 展开一个节点
methods.getPositions: 节点当前的位置（布局单位）
methods.getRenderer: 正在使用的后端（webgpu、webgl2、webgl、canvas2d），就绪前为 null
